title: Mechanical joints.
officialText:
Mechanical joints in drainage piping shall be made with an elastomeric seal conforming to
ASTM C 1173, ASTM D 3212 or CAN/CSA B602. Mechanical joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s
instructions.
